title: S1000RR M Package (Dark Edition)
description: Representing BMW Motorrad's prowess in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the BMW Motorrad S1000RR M Package (Dark Edition) is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. A 1000cc powerplant pumps out 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
